description:
## Goal

Make every production ordering of activation-bearing jobs and facts depend on one total structural semantic key, independent of World-local type interning, hash discovery order, lossy display rendering, or reused binder-address tokens.

This is a correctness prerequisite discovered by the fz-kdt.46 exact-edge review. It must land separately so the edge ticket contains only edge registration, settlement, arbitration, and causal accounting.

## Proven failures

- Derived ordering of ActivationKey.arrow follows raw Ty arena ids, so opposite mint histories reverse wake and diagnostic order.
- Types::display is non-injective: list(int) and non_empty_list(int) both render as [int], so display-derived keys collide.
- Closure-literal captures were not structurally addressed.
- One unscoped variable-correlation map aliases an embedded captured value addressed as a0 with an independent nested callable binder also addressed as a0, while simple precedence changes break intentional arg/return/capture correlation inside one binder.
- Terminal unresolved inventories and product fact waits retained raw FactKey ordering after arbitration moved to a structural key.

## Correct model

- Embedded values belong to the enclosing activation surface.
- Every ArrowSig introduces an explicit binder scope with its own correlation map; sibling and nested binders are distinct.
- Repeated variables within one binder, including its literal captures where semantically shared, remain correlated and addressing is idempotent.
- Embedded captured values are re-owned under an exact Capture path and cannot alias an independent callable binder using the same address token.
- Activation arrows use the existing faithful structural TyCanon, not Debug or display formatting.
- Job, FactKey, FactUse, terminal inventory, product fact wait, completion ordering, and any other observable production order share that one owner-supplied Types-aware key. Remove raw Ord where it can silently re-enter.

## TDD

1. Opposite Ty mint histories plus opposite registration order for display-colliding list/non_empty_list facts produce identical semantic order.
2. A generic named closure capture is fully structurally addressed and stable across worlds.
3. The same a0 token used by an embedded prior value and an independent nested callable binder does not alias; intentional arg/return/capture sharing inside the binder remains correlated after repeated addressing.
4. Sibling/nested callable binders push and pop independently.
5. Unresolved diagnostics and product fact waits have identical order across opposite mint histories.
6. Existing ActivationKey equality, transport, native callable behavior, and canonical artifacts remain unchanged.

## Required deletion and boundary

Delete superseded display-derived comparators, blanket preserve-address modes, unscoped correlation attempts, raw FactKey Ord, duplicate tests/docs, and temporary probes. Do not include fz-kdt.46 wait-edge storage, settlement batching, wake arbitration, or session-accounting changes.

## Acceptance

- One faithful binder-scoped structural ordering path owns every activation-bearing observable order.
- No raw Ty/intern/hash identity, Debug, or non-injective display fallback remains.
- Addressing is total, non-aliasing, correlated, and idempotent for valid activation arrows and nested callable captures.
- Semantic facts, diagnostics, backend/native artifacts, and runtime behavior are identical.
- Focused addressing/TyCanon/ordering/transport tests, full CLI/library/matrix as proportionate, formatting, and strict clippy pass.
title: Give activation facts one binder-scoped semantic order
